user.title: SmartThings Plus Setup
user.description: Enter the URL of your SmartThings PAT Rotator service. The integration will automatically fetch the active 24h Personal Access Token and keep it continuously renewed.

data.rotator_url: SmartThings PAT Rotator URL (e.g. http://smartthings-pat-rotator:8765 or http://192.168.1.50:8765)

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the PAT Rotator at the specified URL. Please ensure the container/service is running.
error.no_token: The Rotator server is reachable, but no active PAT was found. Please run 'smartthings-pat-rotator setup' first.
error.api_error: Connected to the Rotator, but SmartThings rejected the token. Please rotate a fresh token.

abort.already_configured: This SmartThings Plus instance is already configured.
